messages:
Maya K: quick sync — I ran a rolling speculative sampling pass on draft-7b-q4 today, logging perf + quality for a few slices
Derek W: sweet, what did you run exactly?
Maya K: two-stage speculative: cheap 3b quant pass then fallback to full 7b. batch=8, spec_factor=2, cheap-pass=q6, full-pass=q4 per-channel
Linh T: did you enable input-conditioned prefetch? last run had weird cache thrash on long code prompts
Maya K: yes, enabled. heuristic: prompt_len < 128 and contains ``` ``` or "```py" -> aggressive prefetch
Ashley R: preliminary numbers?
Maya K: on 2k dev set: median latency dropped ~24% (210ms -> 160ms), p99 improves ~14% (620ms -> 530ms). token cost -18% steady-state.
Derek W: those are promising. Any change in correctness or hallucination?
Maya K: exact-match fell ~0.6% absolute. hallucination/incorrect facts up ~1.1% on instruction-following slices. chrF for code stayed flat.
Linh T: hmm higher hallucination than expected. sampling params?
Maya K: temp=0.7, top_p=0.95 both passes. cheap-pass temp same but it's quantized q6 weights.
Ashley R: did you try adjusting the acceptance rule or lowering spec_factor?
Maya K: tried spec_factor=1.5 (more conservative), hallucination delta reduced to ~0.4% but latency gain dropped ~12% vs spec_factor=2.
Derek W: possible culprit: quantization mismatch making cheap-pass overconfident on wrong tokens. any logprob ratio patterns?
Maya K: yes, cheap-pass sometimes reports higher normalized logprob for short sequences leading to false accepts. acceptance rule used was:
Maya K: ```
# acceptance rule
if logprob_ratio(cheap, full) > -0.8 and confidence(cheap) > 0.6:
    accept
else:
    fallback
```
Linh T: can we add a stability margin for tokens that change POS or are long entities? e.g., penalize accepts when token spans whitespace or punctuation boundary
Ashley R: also add eval slices: code-gen, conversational clarifications, factual QA. product needs the risk assessment before enabling for hosted tier.
Maya K: agreed. action items: 1) run bootstrap (5x) over 10k prompts; 2) sweep spec_factor in [1.0,1.5,2.0]; 3) try cheap-pass temp 0.9 and also cheap-pass=q4 control; 4) instrument token-level accept decisions and save tokens_saved_per_fallback metric.
Derek W: add a pragmatic control: run cheap-pass using same sampling RNG seed deterministically for analysis to rule out sampling variance
Linh T: I'll enqueue the sweep tonight (queue q-rolling-4711). will also dump per-request accept traces to s3.
ops-bot: job q-rolling-4711 queued by Linh T — ETA ~6h
Maya K: I'll prepare the evaluation harness + human spot-check rubric. plan: 500 random hallucation candidates per run for human review, label by severity and revertability.
Ashley R: ping me when first batch completes. if hallucination >0.7% we should consider gating the rollout.
Maya K: noted. I'll include cost delta and latency percentiles in the report, plus sample diffs for accepted vs fallback outputs. raw logs: s3://redwood-experiments/rolling-sample/2111122334/
Derek W: one more ask: compute per-slice tokens_saved_per_fallback and median accepted run-length to estimate KV-cache impact
Maya K: will add both. wrapping up for now, thanks team.
ops-bot: deploy-benchmark completed — cluster: ded-rt-6, allocs=24, avg_gpu_util=72%
